messages:
joanne_csops: Noticing playbook "send_onboard_checkin" fired for a cohort we intentionally excluded. ~120 runs in last 6h.
mike_data: Huh. Our exclusion flag is `onboarding_exempt=true`. Query shows many rows with onboarding_exempt=NULL. Looks like a backfill failed.
elaine_onboard: Those are mostly trial->paid migrations from last week. We flagged them for manual follow-up, not automated checkins.
infra-bot: deploy: playbook-service v3.9.1 deployed by ci at 2026-04-25T09:12:04Z
joanne_csops: Did we change trigger logic recently? I thought we added `AND onboarding_exempt IS NOT TRUE` to the WHERE clause.
mike_data: We did in staging but the migration that sets onboarding_exempt for migrated accounts didn't finish on prod due to a deadlock. Backfill job `flag-migrated-exempt` shows status=failed at 03:04 UTC.
sam_support: Can we suppress outgoing checkin emails quickly? Our ESP has a send-suppress list.
joanne_csops: First step: pause the playbook: `/playbook pause send_onboard_checkin --reason "backfill failed: suppress"`
infra-bot: command acknowledged: send_onboard_checkin paused by joanne_csops at 2026-04-25T09:18:10Z reason=backfill failed: suppress
mike_data: I'll re-run backfill with smaller batches to avoid deadlocks: `python scripts/rehash_exempt.py --batch-size 500 --dry-run=false` starting now.
elaine_onboard: I'll pull list of accounts that got emails and check if any had account-owner outreach. If so, we'll escalate outreach.
sam_support: Also adding a short-term playbook guard: `AND COALESCE(a.onboarding_exempt,false)=false` -> means only explicit TRUE skips. That'll avoid NULLs being treated as exempt. Push that as a hotfix?
mike_data: Good idea. Patching trigger now and will canary on pb-canary-01 then roll to prod.
joanne_csops: After patch and backfill, run de-dup check to ensure we don't send follow-ups: `SELECT pr.account FROM playbook_runs pr WHERE pr.name='send_onboard_checkin' AND pr.created_at > now()-interval '24 hours' GROUP BY pr.account HAVING count(*)>1;`
elaine_onboard: If any customers received more than one email, we'll consolidate and send clarification.
infra-bot: job queued: run_backfill_flag-migrated-exempt id=job_998 status=running
mike_data: Backfill completed in small batches, no deadlocks. 1,142 accounts flagged onboarding_exempt=true.
sam_support: ESP suppression uploaded for accounts that should not get more emails.
joanne_csops: Thanks. Postmortem items: 1) Backfill should have alerting for deadlocks, 2) Playbook trigger test to cover NULL vs TRUE handling, 3) Add a pre-deploy check for long-running migrations. Opening ticket CSOPS-11009 and assigning owners. ETA mitigation complete in 45m.
elaine_onboard: I'll coordinate outreach for any affected customers with outreach > 0.
joanne_csops: Closing for now. We'll reopen if any regrowth of runs shows up. :thumbsup:
